name: comp-23
title: Password Visibility Toggle
description: A labelled password field with a small eye button at its right edge. Typing hides the characters as dots, and the eye is meant to switch between masked and plain text.
use: A password or secret entry where letting the user peek at what they typed reduces mistakes.
avoid: The eye is a small target inside the field, easy to miss on touch screens.
a11y: The eye is a labelled button with a pressed state, but its aria-controls points at an id the field never has. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small label sits above a rounded dark field on a black stage, with a grey Password placeholder at the left and a faint eye outline inside the right edge. Once typing starts the placeholder gives way to a row of dots while the eye stays put.
behaves: Clicking the field draws a pale ring and typing replaces the placeholder with dots. The eye button is built to toggle between hidden and visible text, but every frame keeps the entry masked.
customise: The label and Password placeholder are fixed in the file; field and eye styling are classes there, and the visible state lives in a small useState.
weight: light: One field and one icon button with a single state flag; nothing runs at rest.
demo: Label Show/hide password input with a Password placeholder and a masked entry.
issues: The eye's aria-controls names an id the input never receives, so the link is broken.
The clip never shows the password revealed, only masked dots in every frame.
polishWhy: Neat field with a clear eye button, but the demo never proves the reveal works.
